summary: Verified the ObjectId-serialization bug fix across all 6 POST endpoints and ran full E2E frontend flows. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (auth, org/project/sprint/task/time-entry/timer creation + persistence, PATCH/DELETE, access control, validation, analytics, seed data). Frontend: login->dashboard->tasks->New Task dialog->task appears in List & Board, all 5 views render, Kanban drag/drop PATCH works, timer start shows orange widget with live ticking elapsed time and stop increments logged_minutes (0h0m -> 0h1m), Create Project / Create Sprint / Invite Member all succeed, new workspace created and its task list is empty, logout clears token and protected routes redirect to /login. One real UI blocking bug found in the org switcher.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests with a wildcard. Currently masked because frontend and backend share the same origin. Should use explicit origin(s) from env.
No brute-force protection / account lockout after repeated failed attempts (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails).
project_id and sprint_id are not validated against the org — a task can be created referencing a project from another org (or a deleted one), and the UI then renders project key as '—'.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKING: After creating a new workspace via 'Create workspace', the workspace DropdownMenu stays mounted/open (radix-popper-content-wrapper remains in DOM) and its overlay intercepts pointer events, so sidebar nav links (nav-tasks, user-menu-btn, etc.) are unclickable until the user presses Escape / clicks elsewhere. Cause: DropdownMenuItem 'create-org-menu' uses onSelect e.preventDefault() to keep the menu open, but the menu is never closed after the dialog submits. Fix: control DropdownMenu open state and set it to false when opening/submitting the create-workspace dialog.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on TaskDialog (and other dialogs) — add DialogDescription
TaskDialog uses native <input type='date'> browser pickers for Start/Due date instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component (inconsistent with the modern light theme requirement)
Tasks whose project no longer exists / belongs to another org render project key as '—' with no tooltip or warning

action_items: Fix org-switcher dropdown staying open after workspace creation — it blocks all sidebar clicks (HIGH)
Replace CORS allow_origins=['*'] with explicit origin(s) since allow_credentials=True
Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to dialogs to clear React a11y warnings
Validate project_id/sprint_id belong to the org in POST/PATCH /tasks
Consider login attempt lockout (5 failures) as per auth playbook
critical_code_review_comments: The insert_and_get() helper at server.py:108 is defined but unused — all 6 sites inline dict(doc)+pop('_id'). Either use the helper everywhere or delete it (dead code).

POST /orgs/{id}/timer/start uses insert_one(doc) (mutates doc with ObjectId) and then filters _id via a comprehension; it works but is inconsistent with the other 6 fixed sites — use insert_one(dict(doc)) for consistency.
start_timer reads task_id from a raw request body instead of a Pydantic model — no validation/typing; add a TimerStart model.

PATCH /tasks drops falsy-but-valid values: updates filter is `if v is not None` (good) but clearing a field (e.g. removing an assignee/due date) is impossible since None is stripped — no way to unset fields.
Status/priority/type strings are not constrained (no Literal/Enum) — invalid statuses can be stored and would break the Kanban/analytics buckets.

It self-cleans nothing, so orgs named TEST_Org_QA may accumulate — delete them if seen. ObjectId serialization bug is fully fixed. Remaining open item is the org-switcher dropdown overlay blocking sidebar clicks after workspace creation; re-verify by creating a workspace then clicking nav-tasks without pressing Escape.
rca_of_the_issue: ObjectId bug: resolved — insert_one now receives a copy (dict(doc)) so the returned document contains no BSON ObjectId; all POST endpoints return 200 with clean JSON (verified no '_id' key in every create response). Org-switcher bug RCA: AppShell.jsx line 69 DropdownMenuItem 'create-org-menu' calls e.preventDefault() in onSelect to open the dialog, which prevents Radix from closing the DropdownMenu. After submit-new-org, only the Dialog is closed (setNewOrgOpen(false)); the dropdown content wrapper stays mounted with pointer-events capture, making the sidebar and header unclickable until Escape is pressed.
